name: Night Stalker
source:
Coming back home felt good after what happened to your best friend, but when an old ghost appears, will it be for revenge or answers?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
最好的朋友出了那件事後，回家的感覺真好。可如今昔日的幽靈現了身，究竟是為了報仇，還是為了尋找答案？

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
